milestone: M1 - WebKit instance lifecycle on Java 17 via JavaCPP

threadingModel.rationale: GTK core is not thread-safe; all native calls are marshalled via invokeAndWait, giving deterministic ordering for declarative reconciliation.
threadingModel.escapeHatch: attachToExternalLoop(g_idle_add) planned for apps that already own the GTK main loop

classes.name: io.glyph.web.core.lifecycle.WebViewState
classes.role: explicit state machine with ordinal-guarded transitions

classes.name: io.glyph.web.core.lifecycle.NativeHandle
classes.role: contract: nativeId(), nativeAddress(), acceptsReclamation(), close() idempotent

classes.name: io.glyph.web.core.lifecycle.NativeId
classes.role: AtomicLong monotonic ids; prevents address-reuse TOCTOU (fail loud vs use-after-free)

classes.name: io.glyph.web.core.lifecycle.WebKitLifecycleManager
classes.role: ConcurrentHashMap<Long,Entry> registry; liveCount() leak tripwire; reverse-order shutdownAll()

classes.name: io.glyph.web.core.lifecycle.WebKitDispatcher
classes.role: invokeAndWait/post; re-entrant inline execution on UI thread

classes.name: io.glyph.web.core.lifecycle.GUI
classes.role: @GUI marker documenting UI-thread-only methods (zero runtime cost)

classes.name: io.glyph.web.core.runtime.WebKitRuntime
classes.role: process singleton: probe -> bind -> gtk_init_check on dispatcher -> shutdown hook

classes.name: io.glyph.nativeapi.webkit.NativeWebKit
classes.role: INTERNAL thin static bindings (gw_* JNI bridge symbols)

classes.name: io.glyph.nativeapi.webkit.WebKitGTKPointer
classes.role: abstract Pointer subclass hierarchy mirroring GObject inheritance

memoryPolicy.safetyNet: Runtime shutdown hook drains WebKitLifecycleManager in reverse creation order
